about: The GPUs we rent, the engine settings every model shares, and how each card is carved (D-40). Models are in deploy/models/. A topology names its GPU, so a run's topology also records the hardware.

estimates.note: activation peak = max_num_batched_tokens × 2 B × (4·hidden + 2·intermediate); CUDA context and MFU are assumptions. On the 8B slice this predicted 79,701 KV tokens; vLLM measured 79,056 (−0.8 %). GPU mib for H100 and GH200 are the usual nvidia-smi totals; check them on first boot.

gate.why: vLLM refuses to start unless one max-length request fits, so below 1 a deploy only wastes a boot; below 2 the worker serves one long audit at a time (tight)

sliced.purpose: N workers on A100 HAMi slices of 20 GiB and half the SMs each: GPU slicing, routing, affinity and the KV hop between workers

full.purpose: one worker with the whole A100: the model-quality benchmark, and the larger models that do not fit a slice

h100-full.purpose: one worker with the whole H100 (78 GiB requested, below the card's reported size): the newer FP8 models

h100-half.purpose: two workers on H100 halves of 39 GiB: the gateway demo with a 27B model

gh200-full.purpose: one worker with the whole GH200 (92 GiB requested): the newer FP8 models

gh200-half.purpose: two workers on GH200 halves of 46 GiB; HAMi on GH200 is unverified, so this is an experiment

h100-80.name: H100 80 GB PCIe
h100-80.note: PCIe figures; the SXM5 card is faster (3,350 GB/s, 989 TFLOPS), so its floors are conservative
